$comment: Ultima VII game data is copyrighted and never committed. Evaluated by scripts/check-policies.mjs (checkGameData), case-insensitively. The globs name only the original game's layout and savegames, so the data Exult ships itself (content/, data/, *.flx built from Exult's own sources) is unaffected. See docs/agent-boundaries.md.

forbiddenGlobs.why: the unpacked game state directory (gamedat) must not be committed
the original game's static data directory must not be committed
original game speech data must not be committed
original game voice data must not be committed
